items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I liked Fletcher's band when he came out West to the Grand Terrace and played "Christopher Columbus" with Chu Berry and Roy...

ctx.x: How about Don Redman and Fletcher Henderson and that whole thing?
Well, I liked Fletcher's band when he came out West to the Grand Terrace and played "Christopher Columbus" with Chu Berry and Roy...
